# SolversPro

> 100% free, fast, and secure problem-solving utilities and developer calculators running client-side in your web browser.

## Key Facts

- **Price**: 100% free with no registration, no subscription, and no paywalls.
- **Privacy & Security**: All data processing and transformations execute 100% client-side in the browser. Zero payload logging or server storage.
- **Performance**: Instant execution powered by native JavaScript/WebAssembly with offline support and PWA capabilities.
- **Catalog**: 80+ specialized problem solvers spanning developer tools, math calculators, finance modeling, health metrics, and PDF utilities.

## Core Hubs & Tool Categories

- [All Tools Directory](https://solverspro.com/all-tools/): Complete searchable directory of 80+ free calculators and utilities.
- [Internet Speed Test](https://speed.solverspro.com/): Accurate real-time internet speed test measuring download, upload, ping, jitter, and bufferbloat against Cloudflare edge network.
- [Universal AI Solver](https://solverspro.com/free-ai-solver/): Gemini-powered multimodal step-by-step problem solver for math, science, and engineering questions.

## Pages & Tools

### Developer Tools

- [Code Minifier](https://solverspro.com/developer/code-minifier/): Instantly minify HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Remove whitespace, comments, and optimize your code for production.
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/markdown-to-html/): Convert Markdown text into clean HTML code instantly. Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM).
- [URL Slug Generator](https://solverspro.com/developer/slug-generator/): Convert any text into a SEO-friendly URL slug. Instantly remove special characters, spaces, and generate clean slugs.
- [UUID v4 Generator](https://solverspro.com/developer/uuid-generator/): Generate cryptographically secure UUID v4 identifiers instantly. Bulk generate up to 100 UUIDs at once.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-tools/): Format, validate, and minify JSON data. Convert nested JSON structures into easy-to-read data tables.
- [XML Formatter & Validator](https://solverspro.com/developer/xml-tools/): Format, validate, and minify XML documents. Parse complex XML into interactive data tables.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://solverspro.com/developer/base64-converter/): Quickly encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text.
- [JWT Token Decoder](https://solverspro.com/developer/jwt-decoder/): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (JWT) payload and header data securely.
- [Hash Generator](https://solverspro.com/developer/hash-generator/): Generate cryptographic hashes like SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 from any text.
- [Color Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/color-converter/): Convert color codes between HEX, RGB, and HSL formats instantly.
- [Number Base Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/number-base/): Convert numbers between binary (base 2), octal (base 8), decimal (base 10), and hexadecimal (base 16).
- [Regex Tester & Debugger](https://solverspro.com/developer/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions in real-time with live match highlighting, flags, and capture group inspection.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/timestamp-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates or date strings to Unix timestamps instantly.
- [JSON ↔ CSV Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-csv/): Convert JSON arrays to CSV spreadsheets or CSV data back to JSON. Handles nested objects with dot-notation flattening.
- [JSON ↔ YAML Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-yaml/): Convert between JSON and YAML formats instantly. Perfect for Kubernetes configs, CI/CD pipelines, and API specs.
- [XML ↔ CSV Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/xml-csv/): Transform XML documents into CSV tables or convert CSV data into structured XML. Great for legacy data migration.
- [XML ↔ YAML Converter](https://solverspro.com/developer/xml-yaml/): Convert between XML and YAML formats. Useful for config file migration and cross-platform data exchange.
- [HTML Escape & Unescape](https://solverspro.com/developer/html-escape/): Escape HTML special characters to entities or unescape entities back to readable HTML. Prevent XSS vulnerabilities.
- [XML Escape & Unescape](https://solverspro.com/developer/xml-escape/): Escape XML special characters or unescape XML entities. Safely embed text in XML documents.
- [JSON Escape & Unescape](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-escape/): Escape strings for embedding in JSON or unescape JSON-encoded strings back to plain text.
- [SQL Escape](https://solverspro.com/developer/sql-escape/): Escape single quotes, backslashes, and special characters for safe SQL string literals.
- [CSV Escape](https://solverspro.com/developer/csv-escape/): Escape CSV fields per RFC 4180 — properly quote fields containing commas, quotes, and newlines.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-to-typescript/): Generate TypeScript interfaces from JSON data. Infers types, handles nested objects, arrays, and optional fields.
- [JSON to Java](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-to-java/): Generate Java POJO classes with getters, setters, and proper type mapping from any JSON structure.
- [JSON to Python](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-to-python/): Generate Python dataclasses with type annotations from JSON. Supports nested structures and lists.
- [JSON to C#](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-to-csharp/): Generate C# classes with auto-properties and proper .NET type mapping from JSON objects.
- [JSON to Go](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-to-go/): Generate Go structs with json tags from JSON data. Handles nested objects and proper Go naming conventions.
- [JSON Diff](https://solverspro.com/developer/json-diff/): Compare two JSON objects side by side. Highlights added, removed, and changed keys with color-coded output.
- [XML Diff](https://solverspro.com/developer/xml-diff/): Compare two XML documents with line-by-line diff highlighting. Find differences in structure and content.
- [Text Diff](https://solverspro.com/developer/text-diff/): Compare two blocks of text with a unified diff view. Highlights additions, deletions, and modifications line by line.
- [HTML Beautifier](https://solverspro.com/developer/html-beautifier/): Format and indent messy HTML code with configurable indentation. Makes minified HTML readable instantly.
- [CSS Beautifier](https://solverspro.com/developer/css-beautifier/): Format compressed CSS into clean, readable stylesheets. One property per line with proper brace alignment.
- [JavaScript Beautifier](https://solverspro.com/developer/js-beautifier/): Format minified JavaScript into readable, properly indented code. Handles braces, semicolons, and nesting.

### Network Utilities

- [Internet Speed Test](https://speed.solverspro.com): Accurate, real-time internet speed test powered by Cloudflare edge. Measure download, upload, ping, jitter, and bufferbloat.
- [IP Subnet Calculator](https://solverspro.com/network/ip-subnet-calculator/): Calculate network address, broadcast, subnet mask, host range, and usable hosts for any IPv4 subnet using CIDR notation.
- [My IP Checker](https://solverspro.com/network/my-ip/): Instantly find your public IP address with location, ISP, timezone, and coordinates.
- [IP Address Lookup](https://solverspro.com/network/ip-lookup/): Look up any public IP address to find its geolocation, ISP, ASN, timezone, and network details.

### Text & String Utilities

- [Number to Words Converter](https://solverspro.com/text/number-to-words/): Convert numbers into English words instantly. Useful for writing checks, filling out forms, or learning English numbers.
- [Word Counter](https://solverspro.com/text/word-counter/): Real-time word, character, sentence, and paragraph counter with reading time estimate and keyword density.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://solverspro.com/text/morse-code/): Translate text to Morse code and back. Includes audio playback with adjustable speed.
- [URL Encoder & Decoder](https://solverspro.com/text/url-encoder/): Encode or decode URLs and query strings instantly. Supports encodeURIComponent and encodeURI modes.
- [Text Case Converter](https://solverspro.com/text/case-converter/): Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, kebab-case, and more.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://solverspro.com/text/lorem-ipsum/): Generate placeholder Lorem Ipsum text by paragraphs, sentences, or words. Customizable and instant.

### PDF Document Tools

- [PDF Merger](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-merger/): Drag, reorder, and combine multiple PDF files into a single document instantly.
- [Split PDF By Range](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-split-range/): Extract a specific page range (e.g. pages 3–8) from any PDF file.
- [Split PDF To Pages](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-split-pages/): Separate every PDF page into its own individual downloadable file.
- [Compose PDF](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-compose/): Create a PDF document from scratch using a built-in text editor.
- [Protect PDF](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-protect/): Add password protection and set read/print/copy permissions on PDFs.
- [Remove PDF Password](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-remove-password/): Unlock and remove password protection from a PDF file.
- [Flatten PDF](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-flatten/): Flatten form fields and annotations for universal compatibility.
- [Preflight PDF](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-preflight/): Inspect PDF metadata, page count, dimensions, and structure.
- [PDF to Text](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-to-text/): Extract all readable text from any PDF document.
- [PDF to Images](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-to-images/): Convert each PDF page into a high-quality PNG image file.
- [PDF to HTML](https://solverspro.com/pdf/pdf-to-html/): Convert PDF content into an HTML page you can preview and download.
- [Images to PDF](https://solverspro.com/pdf/images-to-pdf/): Combine multiple JPG/PNG/WebP images into a single PDF file.
